name: moh731V2023Moh729bInfantBase
description: MOH 729B F-MAPS, PMTCT Infants: the HEI encounters in the month on ARV prophylaxis -- AZT, NVP or another recorded (moh731V2023Moh729bInfantEncounters) by regimen -- PC1X any other (another drug, or not AZT + NVP and not NVP alone from 6 weeks of age); otherwise PC8 if breastfeeding, PC7 if not (an encounter with no feeding recorded gets no code and is left out) -- and the form's age band at the encounter: 0-12 weeks (under 84 days), 12 weeks-6months (84 days to 6 completed months), 7- 9 months, 10-12 months, Above 12 months. One row per encounter, oldest first: the service keeps each infant's latest per code and band, as COUNT(DISTINCT patient) per cell.

join.joinCondition: pn.person_name_id = (SELECT pn2.person_name_id FROM amrs.person_name pn2 WHERE pn2.person_id = x.patient_id AND pn2.voided = 0 ORDER BY pn2.preferred DESC, pn2.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1)

expressionOptions.expression: (SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = x.patient_id AND pi.identifier_type = 38 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = x.patient_id AND pi.identifier_type = 8 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

IF(DATEDIFF(x.encounter_datetime, p.birthdate) < 84, CONCAT(FLOOR(DATEDIFF(x.encounter_datetime, p.birthdate) / 7), ' weeks'), CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, p.birthdate, x.encounter_datetime), ' months'))
CASE WHEN x.breastfeeding = 1 THEN 'Breastfeeding' WHEN x.not_breastfeeding = 1 THEN 'Not breastfeeding' ELSE 'Not recorded' END
COALESCE(NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' + ', IF(x.has_azt = 1, 'AZT', NULL), IF(x.has_nvp = 1, 'NVP', NULL), IF(x.has_other = 1, 'Other', NULL)), ''), 'Not recorded')

CASE WHEN x.has_other = 1 OR NOT ((x.has_azt = 1 AND x.has_nvp = 1) OR (x.has_azt = 0 AND x.has_nvp = 1 AND DATEDIFF(x.encounter_datetime, p.birthdate) >= 42)) THEN 'PC1X' WHEN x.breastfeeding = 1 THEN 'PC8' WHEN x.not_breastfeeding = 1 THEN 'PC7' END

CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(x.encounter_datetime, p.birthdate) < 84 THEN '0-12 weeks' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, p.birthdate, x.encounter_datetime) < 7 THEN '12 weeks-6months' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, p.birthdate, x.encounter_datetime) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN '7- 9 months' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, p.birthdate, x.encounter_datetime) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN '10-12 months' ELSE 'Above 12 months' END

conditions.conditionExpression: (CASE WHEN x.has_other = 1 OR NOT ((x.has_azt = 1 AND x.has_nvp = 1) OR (x.has_azt = 0 AND x.has_nvp = 1 AND DATEDIFF(x.encounter_datetime, p.birthdate) >= 42)) THEN 'PC1X' WHEN x.breastfeeding = 1 THEN 'PC8' WHEN x.not_breastfeeding = 1 THEN 'PC7' END) IS NOT NULL
